findings.title: Direct-to-Main Modification of Production Scoring Logic

evidence.observation: Commit 53393dd0b993cef5a6c428f6afad754283744526 explicitly documents a direct-to-main change modifying core scoring and brief rendering code (classifier.py, intelligence_analyst.py, captains_brief.py) without PR review or automated regression test execution.

proposed_action.description: Enforce branch protection rules on main requiring pull request reviews and CI test suite validation before merging.

findings.expected_benefit: Eliminates risk of introducing regressions or unreviewed scoring logic into live production services.

findings.title: Filesystem Audit Source Python File Detection Failure

evidence.observation: Filesystem audit reported 0 python_files despite 74 test files being present and recent commits modifying classifier.py, intelligence_analyst.py, and captains_brief.py.

proposed_action.description: Update repository audit file pattern matching to accurately discover and count core application Python files.

findings.expected_benefit: Ensures accurate telemetry and inventory tracking for repository analysis and reporting.

findings.title: Unlisted Model 'gemini-flash-latest' Configured in Router Policy

evidence.observation: Model router policy assigns 'gemini-flash-latest' to multiple tasks (intelligence-brief, captain-insight-synthesis, captain-reasoning-synthesis, billing-report, self-improvement-*, adhd-decompose), but the model is absent from the router's available_models catalog.

proposed_action.description: Register gemini-flash-latest in the router model registry or verify external API connector catalog syncing.

findings.expected_benefit: Prevents potential routing failures or unvalidated fallback execution when calling Gemini tasks.
